description: A PMID is canonical ASCII digits, or it is not sent (bmlib#470, #472, #478 at f4b7c52). A caller's PMID reaches Europe PMC's EXT_ID query, NCBI's ID Converter and efetch, so it is read once at the entry: surrounding whitespace is stripped; a blank is no PMID and is not refused; ASCII digits [0-9]+ that are not all zeros are the PMID without their leading zeros (Europe PMC finds nothing for the padded form); 'PMC' then ASCII digits is a PMC ID given as a PMID and is read as one (pmc_id), with pmid null; anything else (a prefix, a suffix, a space inside, a sign, a decimal point, non-ASCII digits, all zeros, lower-case pmc) is refused, which the apps log naming the value and then proceed as though no PMID were given. A PMC ID given as a PMID fills the PMC ID only when the caller gave none. Python alone also reads integers (its digits; 0 is no PMID; bool is refused). Read by tests/test_identifiers.py, Packages/BioMedLit PMIDCanonicalTests and Android PmidCanonicalTest. A case gives the input as text, the pmid read (null for none), the pmc_id read, and whether it was refused.
